infra-bot: [ALERT] hosted-api p99 latency spike detected on region-us-west-2 · p95 420ms -> 780ms, p99 1.1s -> 1.9s · 1901123456
alyssa: noticed the alert, landing in #eng-runtime. any obvious tenant causing heap?
miguel: looking at top tenants now, running quick query against request logs.
kai: grabbing metrics from runtime: queue depth jumped from ~40 to ~210 around 1901123420, batching window increased to 12ms avg for several GPUs.
alyssa: any recent deploys to kernel-heuristics or batching?
miguel: we pushed kernel-selection tweak three hours ago (rollout 20%). heuristic now prefers fused-attn kernel at seq<=1024, default threshold lowered.
kai: profiler snapshot attached (link): /internal/prof/1901123456/flame.html — shows CPU spin waiting on KV cache lookup for one shard.
sre-oncall: i see a tenant with a burst of long-prefix requests, high token lengths -> KV cache miss ratio for that tenant jumped from 4% -> 48% in 10m.
alyssa: that noisy tenant could be causing large batch formation and kernel mispredicts (fused-attn chosen but actual seq distribution higher). can we confirm kernel mismatch rate?
miguel: ran a quick grep on logs: "kernel_mismatch=true" spikes align with the p99 window. counts: 3.2k mismatches in 8m.
kai: mismatch + bigger batches means the runtime falls back to generic kernel mid-request, causing stall and queue buildup.
alyssa: options: 1) rollback heuristic rollout -> reduces mismatches; 2) apply soft rate limit to noisy tenant; 3) force small-batch cap for hosted queues; 4) evict KV cache entries for that tenant. which to try first?
sre-oncall: recommend immediate mitigation: add a temporary per-tenant QPS cap and evict KV entries for that tenant. will coordinate with infra-bot.
miguel: I'll prepare a rollback patch in case QPS cap doesn't help. patch id in CI: #4821.
kai: quick commands:
```
# evict tenant KV
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" https://admin.redwood.internal/kv/evict -d '{"tenant":"tenant-314"}'
# set soft cap
rbctl set-rate-limit --tenant tenant-314 --qps 8 --window 60
```
alyssa: applied soft cap now. infra-bot, can you throttle traffic back?
infra-bot: rate-limit update applied for tenant-314 QPS=8 at 1901123492 by alyssa
miguel: starting rollback canary to 0% -> 0. I'll stand by, CI shows step ready.
Kai: after cap + evict, queue depth dropped from 210 -> 70 over ~40s, batching window back to 4ms, p99 trending down to ~980ms.
sre-oncall: good, p95 also back to 360ms. keep monitoring for 15m.
timothy: will follow up with deeper flamegraphs and a histogram of seq lengths for tenant-314 to root cause the KV priming behavior.
alyssa: next steps: (1) run full flamegraph diff after spike, (2) revert or adjust kernel-heuristic thresholds, (3) add tenant-level preforking guard so very long prefixes don't cause global batch blowups, (4) postmortem if rollout caused regression. assign owners: miguel rollback, kai profiling, timothy tenant analysis, alyssa lead postmortem.
infra-bot: incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. alerts suppressed for 10m.
alyssa: thanks all. we'll reconvene if p99 creeps back up. :thumbsup:
